lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Willow Pang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Willow is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Willow Pang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Willow kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Willow's gone." Gladys looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Willow." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Rahul blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Willow Pang, 41 days. The mantle passes to Rahul Smirnov.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Rahul Smirnov, 56 — a postal worker. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Bloodhound, Trophy Room.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Willow — and Willow is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Deirdre, Gladys, Catarina and 6 more speak for Rahul — "Willow trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Rahul before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
